answer: A withdrawal needs a 3,000,000 rupiah bond and a committed hash of the claim. Daily a beacon at a tundra station publishes a signed pulse; the holder must reveal it within an hour, when a pulse's last digit matches the claim's. Two verifiers check hash, pulse and timing within a day; a missed window or bad hash forfeits it. One honest holder gets it back; 1,000 fakes must lock 3 billion rupiah, and only passing claims enter the walled garden.
